thread:
support-oliver: FYI AcmeCorp says their usage numbers are zeroed for ~7 hours (2026-03-16 02:00-09:00 UTC). Billing shows discrepancy. Ticket INC-8421. Can we triage?
ingestor-bot: alert: analytics-ingest consumer group lag spike detected 02:03 UTC, rebalancing noted :eyes:
alan: Do we know if there was any DB maintenance/restore around that time? CDC could have been interrupted.
support-jane: Customer confirms we performed a point-in-time restore on events-db at ~01:50 UTC to recover a corrupted index. They said CDC should've resumed but console shows zeros.
devops-maya: Confirmed — we restored replica via wal-g, and pglogical connector logs show a pause. Postgres LSN jumped forward during restore, connector restarted and appears to have skipped the 02:00-02:10 window due to offset mapping. I'm seeing connector offsets reset to earliest for that partition.
ingest-oncall: Quick checks: primary still has rows. Analytics cluster returns 0 for that tenant/time window, so this is an ETL gap.
alan: Minimal repro SQL for analytics cluster: ```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE tenant = 'acme_corp' AND ts >= '2026-03-16T02:00:00Z' AND ts < '2026-03-16T09:00:00Z';
-- returns 0
```
devops-maya: Plan: run a targeted backfill using the replication manifest created at restore: s3://redwood-backups/replication-manifests/2026-03-16-01-50-manifest.json. Command: ```bash
redwood-backfill --manifest s3://redwood-backups/replication-manifests/2026-03-16-01-50-manifest.json \
  --tenant acme_corp \
  --start 2026-03-16T02:00:00Z --end 2026-03-16T09:00:00Z \
  --outcome metrics,events
```
support-oliver: Customer is worried about billing impact. Can we provide provisional usage numbers before finalizing invoice?
finance-sam: We can issue a provisional credit if backfill confirms missed ingestion. Tagging accounting, will prepare a provisional statement and hold final billing until verification.
ingest-oncall: I'll kick the backfill in ~10m and post job id. Estimated time ~2 hours for 7h window given shard sizes.
support-jane: Updating INC-8421 with timeline and letting customer know ETA.
ingest-oncall: Started backfill job id backfill-8421-01. Logs excerpt: ```
[INFO] processed 0/1,200,000 events for tenant=acme_corp
[INFO] reading manifest s3://redwood-backups/replication-manifests/2026-03-16-01-50-manifest.json
```
devops-bot: job backfill-8421-01 failed at 4325679700 due to S3 timeout (HEAD/GET), automatic retry queued (attempt 2/3).
devops-maya: Retry succeeded, job resumed. Current progress: ~40% of window processed, metrics ingestion showing catch-up below latency SLO but filling.
support-jane: Customer reports console numbers are starting to populate, they see partial backfill (+~4h). I'm keeping them updated.
support-oliver: Great — keep INC-8421 up-to-date. Once backfill completes we'll validate usage vs primary and decide on crediting.
devops-maya: Postbackfill checks: run this on analytics cluster to validate: ```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE tenant='acme_corp' AND ts >= '2026-03-16T02:00:00Z' AND ts < '2026-03-16T09:00:00Z';
``` If counts match primary, mark resolved and coordinate with finance.
finance-sam: I'll hold billing until validation. If mismatch, we'll issue pro-rata credit and follow up.
alan: Noted we should add a post-restore checklist to pause producers/connectors or freeze offset mapping next time to avoid this window. Filing follow-up RFC.
support-oliver: Thanks all — posting updates to INC-8421 and will close once validation and finance confirmation complete. :thumbsup:
